text:
maria (Docs): Quick sync — I'm landing a migration checklist for Optimize v2 (batching/cache/quant profile API changes). Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 :wave:

sam (Eng): Nice. What's the big change users will hit?

maria (Docs): The quant profile schema renamed `dtype` -> `tensor_type` and the batching config moved under `runtime.batch` in v2. Need clear migration steps + one-liner SDK examples.

devon (ML): Also want to call out that prefix KV caching default behavior changes — prefetch is opt-in now. Small perf note in the guide.

akshay (SDK): I'll add a code snippet to show how to convert a v1 profile programmatically. Example draft: ```python
# convert_v1_to_v2.py
from redwood.optimize import QuantProfile
q2 = QuantProfile.migrate_from_v1(open('q_profile_v1.json'))
print(q2.to_json())
```

leo (Review): Can we include a tiny benchmark showing latency delta for a 2048-token seq? Helps folks decide whether to enable prefetch.

devon (ML): I have micro-bench numbers: v1 default vs v2 (prefetch disabled) -- 14% lower throughput when prefetch off for small batch loads. I'll paste numbers in a follow-up comment.

maria (Docs): Awesome. Also need a migration checklist bullet list for release notes and a sample `mkdocs` redirect entry.

akshay (SDK): For the SDK example inline in the docs, prefer a single-shot snippet not a full script. Like: ```python
from redwood import Optimize
client = Optimize()
client.migrate_quant_profile('/path/profile_v1.json')  # returns v2 profile json
```

maria (Docs): Perfect. Can you add that to PR and push a small unit test that validates fields `tensor_type` exists after migration? I can copy the test snippet into the docs under "automated migration".

akshay (SDK): Yep — pushing in a sec. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/987 (draft). Commit abc1234 -> will add test.

leo (Review): On the docs wording — avoid using "breaking" too often. Call it "schema update with automated conversion" so it's less scary for customers.

maria (Docs): Good call. I'll update the language. Also need help with one link that's 404ing in the migration guide: the old quant profile reference. Who maintains that page?

sam (Eng): That was moved during the docs restructure last quarter. Link should be /optimize/quant-profiles/reference-v2. I'll update the anchor.

maria (Docs): Thanks. Can someone trigger a preview build after akshay's SDK snippet lands? Want to verify code formatting and the redirect works.

doc-bot: Preview deployed for PR 4321 -> https://deploy-preview-4321--redwood-docs.netlify.app/optimize/migration-v2 (expires in 7 days) :rocket:

maria (Docs): Preview looks good but the code block lost highlighting on the migrate example. Maybe wrong fence language.

akshay (SDK): Fixed — changed ```python to ```py to match our mkdocs highlighter. Pushed final commit abc1234f.

leo (Review): I left two nit comments on the PR (grammar + a link). After those, I'm happy to approve.

devon (ML): Pasting quick micro-benchdump for the doc: "test harness: 8xA100, batch sizes 1/8/32, seq=2048; v1 throughput 420 tok/s, v2 (no prefetch) 360 tok/s; v2 (prefetch) 405 tok/s". Add as a small table.

maria (Docs): I'll add the table and an explanatory note recommending enabling prefetch for small-batch interactive workloads.

sam (Eng): One more ask — update the troubleshooting section with `runtime.batch.max_delay_ms` common pitfalls (users set too high and see latency spikes).

maria (Docs): Noted. I'll create a short FAQ snippet.

akshay (SDK): SDK PR merged -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/987/files . Docs PR updated with SDK snippet and test reference.

doc-bot: docs CI passed for PR 4321 (mkdocs build, linkcheck).

maria (Docs): Thank you everyone — I'll resolve the nit comments and request final review. Planning to merge tomorrow morning if no objections. :thumbsup:

leo (Review): LGTM pending nit fixes.

maria (Docs): Merging after nitfixes, will post release-note blurb in #announcements once merged.

sam (Eng): Thanks all — great cross-team collab.

maria (Docs): Closing thread — follow-up issues: add example for on-prem quant workflow, and a small migration script in the examples repo. I'll file those after merge.
